strings.en: Spirit's maxed out! Let's do this!
I ain't lettin' this chance slip!
I'll get luck on my side too!
Your luck or mine.../　Wanna see whose is stronger!?
I got no intention of losing here!
I'll show you my luck's/　better than yours!!
If luck counts as skill, there's no way I'll lose!
Once I decide to play, I win. Period!
There ya go, take it all!
This one's gonna hit! No doubt about it!
I never miss on lotteries or targets!
Let 'em have it with the Gandro!
I'll sweep your legs right out from under ya!
This is the ultimate shield... Cut through it if you can!
My skills are still growin', y'know!
This thing packs a punch like the Giganscudo Duro!
Type L's gonna land me the win!
Play this game for kicks and you'll get burned!
Enjoy yourself while you still can!
Don't go thinking you're my rival!
Jua-Mu, I won't let you lay a finger on the Princess!
Let's settle this for real, Al-Van!!
Heh, a match with a Raftclans gives me chills.
A Raftclans, huh? My gambler's blood is boiling.
A lady knight... It's got a nice ring to it, though.
If she's a tsundere, she's just my type.../　Wait, this ain't the time for that!
Don't get cocky just 'cause you're an Agent!
Damn you, Karo-Ran! Black machine, black heart, huh?!
Tasuku Shinguji, man among men!/　Placing the bet of a lifetime!
Here it comes... Here it comes!/　The big showdown!
As a man, I can't lose this big match!
The bigger the big shot, the more fired up I get!
I'm takin' the big boss's head!!
Gu-Landon!/　I'm not handing the Princess over to you!
Go back to Voda's darkness, crying your eyes out!!
Play against me and be ready to lose your shirt!
That type's actually the scariest kind...!
That Raig-Geios is/　up to something...!
So he came for an on-site inspection, huh!
Get out of the way, Gadisword!
I'm getting through to the Rabulpaila!
I said get out of the way, Vort!
I love a good party, but not a blood party!
Herluga, your gamble isn't gonna pay off!
With something that big, I can't miss even if I don't aim!
Debudedabide, I won't lose a magic contest!
That smirk of yours.../　I'm gonna slap it right off!
Its name and looks sure make an impression...
What kind of magic lets you pilot a Zovorg unit?
I'll smash you, Madnet and all!
Once I know the trick, there's nothing to fear!
It's still monster hunting either way!
Bet the face on its chest is the real one.
Let's see if you're getting enough calcium!
I'll knock that shield right out of the way!
Why's that guy talking in Kansai dialect?/　He's all head, so he must be from Kobe?
I'll give you the same treatment Dark Brain got!
I'll send these Zovorg units flying!
I already know what cards you're holding!
Get outta the Earth Sphere, Golaikunru!
Golaikunru, go look for work somewhere else!
Heavyweight, huh? Then let's slug it out!
High-performance unit, so it's got lots of Valu, huh?
I've got fighting that ship down pat!
Somehow, it doesn't feel very Zovorg...
Bet they're actually some other aliens.
I don't care what kind of aliens show up!
I'll kick those rugby balls off your shoulders!
My instincts are screaming... That guy's strong!
Can't go wrong taking out the Thorn!
What the hell did you guys come here for?!
Of the thirty-six stratagems, running's the best!
Tuck your tail and run back to the Rabulpaila!
Don't think a Cupid can stop me!
Getting close to that thing's a little dicey...!
A night parade of demons in the middle of town?!
They're swarming all over the place!
I'll exterminate these Lamaris in no time!
Monster hunting, even without a cursed blade!
I've got a seriously bad feeling about this...!
Combining won't scare the great Tasuku!
Combine all you want, I'll blast you all at once!
Is that a Lamaris too, Kaana be?/　No time to be joking around!
No matter how big you get, I'll do the same thing!
You're gonna deal with me too!
If you park yourself there, it's gonna be trouble!
Is it me, or are there a lot of/　those types this time!?
Not yet! I still got a shot at winnin'!
Ya know what they say?/　The game's just gettin' started!
Thing about a gamble is,/　you don't know till it's over!
The second you let me counter,/　you started losin'!
All right! Let's roll the dice again!!
I still got cards left to play!
I've already put my money down!!
I've been waiting for this moment!
I-I can't believe I'm losin' a bet!!
Wh-Why you! What the hell was that!!
Heh heh.../　Now's when a real gambler shows his stuff!
Gaaah!/　No way I lose at anything called a game!
D-Damn! Is this the moment of truth!?
H-Hangin' on by a thread, huh!?
I-I still got an ace up my sleeve.../　sorta!!
Can't worry about damage! I'm winning no matter what!!
Wh-What!?/　Even the Jigan can't block that!?
I-If this weren't the Jigan,/　I'd be done for...
A Commander unit's tough, all right...!
Ugh!! The big boss's attacks/　are on a whole other level...!
Ch-Cheating can't last forever, you know!
I-I can't get mad at anything a beauty does.../　Is this really the time?!
Crap, did I draw too much attention?!
Looks like Kaana's getting serious, Kaana be.../　Wait, this is seriously bad!
This one's tougher than I figured!
Watch this.../　I'm turnin' this around in one shot!
Ngh! Looks like I'm still a step ahead.
Tch!/　Things are startin' to look cloudy...!
Ugh! This game ain't over yet!!
Dammit!/　I'm the one who's gotta fix this later!
Now I'm gonna come roarin' back!!
Gah!/　What needs fixin'... I mean, what's damaged!?
Heh, heh heh.../　This is the kinda spot that gets me fired up.
You bastard! I'm writin' your name/　in a certain notebook!
Ngh, gotta turn this game around...!
A Pierce or two/　won't bother the Jigan!!
You'll need more Vigor than that/　to bring down this Jigan!
Jinxes? My luck'll take care of them!
He's in a league of his own, even among the Fury...!
Sexy older ladies aren't half bad either.../　Is this the time for that?!
No thank you to the Grim Reaper, Karo-Ran!
How the hell is the Zee-Gadin built?!
L-Like this, I can't go for a big upset...!
Its attacks are just as nasty as it looks...!
I'm not about to end up in a hell of blood pools...!
That bastard Herluga is firing like crazy!
Getting fond attention from a puppet doesn't thrill me!
I'm not getting mummified by that thing!!
It'll smash me before I can smash it!
Damn, this guy's got some backbone...!
Thought I was used to fighting him, but...!
Damn! It's just bulldozing me with raw specs!
Fury, that won't be enough to take me down!
Gah! At this rate, I'm headed for the loss Zone!
Dammit, a monster reading my moves?!
Ngh! Lamaris pile up just like dust, huh?!
You're a Geist, so don't go getting any spookier...!
I'll show you humanity's true potential, XN-L!
Huh!? Did something just hit me?
Ow ow ow.../　Is today my unlucky day or what?
Ugh! I've got a bad feeling about this...
Oh well, can't be helped./　Keep shooting and something'll hit.
That didn't count! Let me take it back!
This much is still easy to patch up.
...What do I do when/　the repair bill shows up?
Ngh! This? It's just a scratch!
Jigan doesn't even need to dodge that!
Hey!/　You put a scratch on Gandoro!
One or two slip-ups won't get me down!
Float like a butterfly... Wait, I got hit!
Speed alone doesn't decide a match, Al-Van!
You threw off my read, Karo-Ran?!
I won't approve of you as Emperor, Gu-Landon!
A rich pretty boy? That pisses me off!
Heh, Lieutenant Katina's punishments hurt way more!
That attitude and those moves/　are both pretty harsh, huh?
Your prized weapons are nothing special, Herluga!
Can't lose as a gambler or as a magician!
If you wanna run wild, go hold a field day in a graveyard!
You think you'll wipe out humanity with that?/　Don't make me laugh!
That Zovorg unit keeps flitting around!
Guess beating him unscathed is asking too much!
Their machines are worse than the Zovorg's.
You've got a good eye!/　Not that I can tell where it is!
Ares Geist is a pain as always!
Get it~?/　Nah, bet you don't~
Hahaha~! Like a dog tripping over itself?
Guess I'm one step ahead of you!
Heh, no tricks up my sleeve.
All right, just like I figured!
I'm not here to entertain you!
Close call! Shook you off, Al-Van!
Whoa there!/　If you're gonna approach me, try another way.
Whew! That's the big boss for you. Nice attack!
Whatever the energy, it's useless if it doesn't hit!
I can see right through your trick, Debudedabide!
All that effort for nothing, huh!
Zovorg units aren't even a warm-up.
No Thorn-y attacks like that, okay?
Like I'd let that thing possess me!
Okay, monsters, off to the haunted house! Shoo, shoo!
Let's just call it a first-class trick.
Didn't even need to take a gamble.
What's wrong? Want me to reveal the trick?
See that!?/　That's the Tasuku Shinguji trick!!
Man, this is cracking me up!
No need to hold back, Fu-Ruu!
Even if you're a woman,/　I can't let you hit me.
Is that all the tricks you've got, Gu-Landon?
You may have money, but you've got no power.
Dodged an attack that wide? Nice one, me!
My hunches are spot-on even against monsters.
Really, these attacks are nothing but tricks.
That stuff won't work on me!
There ya go, run on home!
Uh-oh! I can't attack like this!
Damn, I'm all out of cards!
Hey, hey! Fight fair and square!
Geez, that guy's quick on his feet!
The headliner always shows up last!
The great Tasuku ain't one to/　let a chance like this slip by!
Leona, rely on me a little, will ya!
No enemy can stand up to/　our lovey-dovey attack!
All right! I'm going too, Leona!
Ryoto, the finishing blow is mine!
Sorry, Yuuki, but the glory's mine!
Rio, leave that one to me!
Kusuha, I'll lend you a hand!
Carla, just leave the rest to me!
Lieutenant Kyosuke, I'm in on that bet!
A long-odds bet? You got it!
Big Sis Exce, you call, I come runnin'!
Sis, you can count on me!
Lieutenant Katina, I got your back!
If I don't back her up now,/　she's gonna pound me later...
Russel, leave the rest to me!
Big Sis Radha, I'll lend a hand!
Blast it all! Take this too, ya hear!
Aqua, you can count on me!
I'll lend ya a hand, Arieil!
Cool beauty... I can't get enough!
Rim, leave this to Big Bro Tasuku!
Josh, leave the rest to me!
Yours truly will back up the princess!
We're Team Katina--I got your back!
Tenia, big brother Tasuku's here to help!
Akemi, leave the rest to me!
Worship your big sister, Deadpan Boobs.
Mind if I spill all your secrets? Red Seaweed.
Mind if I tug on them from both sides?/　Those black panties.
Is that all this Bang-Bang Kaiser can do?
Leave this to the great Tasuku!
We all gotta help each other out!
Ryoto, get out of here, now!
Lieutenant, that bet's way too risky!
Russel, get out of here, now!
This is where a knight steps in!
Anyone who lays a hand on a cutie/　answers to the great Tasuku!
Sis, when you're in a pinch,/　Tasuku Shinguji's your man!
Lieutenant Katina,/　please don't shoot at me!
Radha, leave that one to me!
Lamia, I'll take care of this!
What do you think you're doing to my girl!?
Leona, I'll be expecting a reward later!
Whaddaya think you're doin'!? Ya blasted fool!
Aqua, get out of here, now!
Big brother Tasuku's got this one!
Nobody lays a hand on my little sister!
Gettin' by... Wait, this ain't the time!
Lieutenant Calvina, you're too far forward!
Time for the Jigan to show its stuff!!
All right! I'll take you all at once!
I don't care how many there are!/　I'll hit as many as I can!
Blow away with this! High Twin!!
Please, don't attack me right now...!
Spin, iron fist! Drill Boost Knuckle!!
Wanna see how sharp this baby is!?
I look amazing with my clothes off!
I'll fleece every last one of you!!
No tricks, nothing up my sleeve!/　The ever-shifting Oxtongue!
Now then... what'll pop out?/　That's the fun part!!
All right, I'll go with this round!
Your fate's sealed!/　Vanish with this--Blaster!!
Win or lose, one or the other!/　Ultimate! Wide Blaster!!
Gandoro's full power!/　I'll slam it right into ya!!
I'm betting all my chips on Gandoro!!
Gandoro itself is one giant hammer!
There ya go, take it!/　An extra-large Seize Anchor!
When this hits you,/　screaming is mandatory!
Go on, become a star in the sky!!
Boost Hammer!/　Spinning extra today, folks!
I'm not revealing the trick!/　Take this, Leap Slasher!
Or so I said--slice and diiiice!!
Feel like a round of Russian roulette?
The big gamble! All or nothing!!
Take it all, you crook! Dang it!!
This here's the real Claymore./　Uhh, a really real Claymore, get it?
What pops out? You'll have to wait and see!
Running dry? Who's scared of that!!
Here we go, punch right through!!
Special move! Sonic Iron Fist Special!
This'll do more than pop your eyes out!
Super special move: Sonic Ghost!/　What does that even mean?!
Not yet, not yet, not yet!!
Smash, iron fist! Hyper Boost Knuckle!
I'll leave your front end all sooty!!
...Er, make that Sword of Ill Omen.
Your fate's been decided!/　Straight down the drain!
...Even I come through when it counts!
Bring gyoza and fried rice too!
I'll spin more than usual for ya!!
Let's do it!/　G Combination Attack!
Sword Form Three, Shishioh Blade!/　Also known as...!
Okay, this time I end it in one shot!
Come on, if you space out...!!
You'll get sliced right down the front!!
That was a nice, sharp cut!
That way, this way, every which way!
Aw, what the heck, everything must go!/　Take this!!
I'm betting big here.../　If this misses, I'm ruined!
Now then, this trick's got plenty up its sleeve!
By the time you notice, it's too late!
One shot to win it all!
The stakes are the Boxer and me!
Stick with me to the end!
It's a giveaway! Take it all, you thief!
Eat this and get blown away!!
Sliders are all in how you use 'em!
I'll pitch you an extra-big ball!
Don't be shocked by this trick!
Code DTD activated~ Leave it to me!
I'll finish with an ultra-difficult move!
I'll leave you with a sooty back!
Bottom of the ninth, two outs, bases loaded!!
Full swing, right down the middle!
Now this is a real walk-off hit!
Too fast for the eye to see!
And finally, right down the middle...!
Let's see if you can match my speed!
Flying with my nose held high!
This'll be more than a scratch!
Hear the hound of hell howl!
A night parade of demons? No problem!
Once I bite, I don't let go!!
Time to unveil my secret weapon!
Fire this much and something's bound to hit!
